videos.title: The estimated progression of reselling
videos.summary: Lesson 1 of the reselling course: buy low from vendors, the profit math on one flip, reinvesting into bulk lots, building a following, and a realistic month-by-month path. Ends with a recap and a quick-check question.

brief.text:
Make an ASCENTRA lesson video following prompts/ascentra-lesson-video-prompt.md.

Course: Online reselling and flipping
Module 1 · Lesson 1: The estimated progression of reselling,
Learning objective: By the end the user can identify how reselling works online and see how their future in the side hustle will most likely look.
Student level: Beginner
Key points, in order:
  1. Buying from vendor
  2. Expanding to start making bulk orders
  3. marketing and gaining followers
  4. any other key points that should be in
Length: about 60 s
Style: Papercraft 3D diorama (keep the course look if this course already has one)
Voice: Male, steady (am_fenrir)
Formats: 16:9

Teaching video only: no branding, sales or call to action. Show me stills before rendering, then render, mix, commit, push, send me the MP4s and add the lesson to the Studio Hub.

videos.title: Grow an online store with Google Ads
videos.summary: The very first video: started as an HTML animation, polished with the improve-animations skill, redesigned as liquid glass, then given the Midnight palette, a voice-over and music.

videos.title: Making-of reel: Draft to Midnight to Ocean
videos.summary: A 9:16 reel that replays how the first explainer evolved, switching to the Ocean palette part-way through.

videos.title: Booked jobs, not leads
videos.summary: The first Elevate Home Ads video, built from the reusable prompt: 60 leads a month but only 1 to 3 booked jobs, and a system that grows the booked number.

videos.title: Booked jobs, in papercraft
videos.summary: The booked-jobs story remade as a three.js paper diorama after an Instagram reference, then a v2 with squash-and-stretch, pop-up entrances and a 16:9 layout.

videos.title: Inquiries into estimates
videos.summary: Walks through the inquiry-to-booking process as a little isometric city.

videos.title: Leads feel unqualified?
videos.summary: Explains qualifying leads before scheduling, drawn on a whiteboard.

videos.title: Is your marketing working?
videos.summary: Tracking booked estimates by lead source, as a bold neo-brutalist infographic.

videos.title: Follow-up on autopilot
videos.summary: A simple follow-up workflow, demonstrated in a product-style interface.

videos.title: The insider-workflow website
videos.summary: How a project-planner flow on a contractor's site turns visitors into booked estimates.

videos.title: Mind the Leads
videos.summary: A 10-second cutout-collage ad made from the long director prompt.

videos.title: First Reply Wins
videos.summary: A second collage spot from the same director prompt: the first contractor to reply wins the job.

videos.title: You don't have a lead problem
videos.summary: LEAD turns into LEAK, the three leaks are listed, then the free Leak Audit.

videos.title: What happens on a Leak Audit
videos.summary: Five questions, a 30-minute call mapping the funnel by hand, and a one-page leak report.

videos.title: The $14,000 estimate nobody chased
videos.summary: Monday the estimate goes out, Friday a competitor signs her. Then the same estimate, signed.

videos.title: No long contracts
videos.summary: A 6-second YouTube bumper: the contract snaps, results climb, the lockup lands.

videos.title: The leak calculator
videos.summary: 60 leads, a $12k average job, 5 lost: $60,000 a month rolls in like an odometer.

videos.title: Same 60 leads, two companies
videos.summary: Next-day callbacks against 2-minute replies: 6 jobs versus 14 from the same leads.

videos.title: Missed call, text back in 30 sec
videos.summary: A missed call becomes an automatic text, a reply and a booked inspection.

videos.title: Burned by agencies?
videos.summary: The agency invoice burns away, then three promises check on.
